name: Crew Recruiter: Izgradi Ekipu
description: Popuni 5 uloga za jedan nastup vučenim kartama, upravljaj sinergijom i zamenama kroz 6 faza događaja da podigneš Vibe Score.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap, game start/restart/event-type selection, wire all modules
modules.src/config.js: SVE konstante: VIBE_START/MAX/MIN, CHURN_PENALTY, EMPTY_SLOT_PENALTY, IMPATIENCE_PENALTY, PHASE_WEIGHTS/THRESHOLDS, MAX_SYNERGY_PER_ROUND, SYNERGY_PAIRS (10 pairs), PHASES array, SLOT_ROLES, EVENT_TYPE_CONFIGS, RARITY thresholds
modules.src/state.js: GameState shape: hand[], slots[5], graveyard[], vibe_score, phase_index, completedRuns, eventType, churnCountThisRound; save/load localStorage; resetForNewRun()
modules.src/entities/card.js: Card: {id, name, role, power, rarity, flavor}; factory function createCard(data)
modules.src/entities/slot.js: Slot: {role, card|null, isEmpty()}; assignCard(card), clearCard() methods
modules.src/systems/deck.js: createDeck(eventType), shuffle(deck), drawCards(n, state) → drawn cards, track graveyard
modules.src/systems/resolution.js: resolveRound(slots, phase, isRound1) → {weightedPower, synergyBonus, emptyPenalty, impatiencePenalty, churnPenalty, roundDelta}
modules.src/systems/synergy.js: detectActivePairs(slots) → [{pair, bonus, name}]; calcSynergyTotal(pairs) → capped sum
modules.src/systems/hall_of_fame.js: getHallOfFame() → last 3 scores; addToHOF(score); isHOFUnlocked() (>= 3 completed runs)
modules.src/render.js: Orchestrates DOM rendering: coordinates cards.js, slots.js, vibe-meter.js, ending-screen.js, menu.js
modules.src/ui.js: HUD updates: phase name, round counter, vibe display; phase transition animations; synergy feed notifications
modules.src/ui/cards.js: Card DOM elements: render hand, drag-start/end, click-to-slot, highlight assignable slots, synergy glow on active pairs
modules.src/ui/slots.js: Slot DOM: render 5 slots with role labels, empty/filled states, drop zone highlighting, churn indicator
modules.src/ui/vibe-meter.js: Animated Vibe Score bar: smooth CSS transition, color change by range (green/yellow/red), bump animation on roundDelta
modules.src/ui/ending-screen.js: Ending screen: 1:1 aspect ratio, score-gated tagline, Guncati CTA link, share button; aria-live for final score
modules.src/ui/menu.js: Main menu: event type selector (locked/unlocked), HOF display (after 3 runs), Play button
modules.src/ui/synergy-display.js: Synergy pair display: list active pairs this round with bonus values; fade-in per pair; pulse animation
modules.src/ui/tutorial.js: First-run tooltip overlays: step 1=draw, step 2=assign, step 3=synergy, step 4=Vibe Score; localStorage flag to skip on replay
modules.src/input.js: Pointer events API (touch+mouse unified): drag/drop cards to slots, click-to-slot fallback; keyboard: space=confirm, escape=discard
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API: crowd ambient (sine + noise, volume ramps up through phases), SFX: vinyl scratch (draw), muffled thud (assign), bass drop (synergy trigger), feedback squeal (vibe drop below 30)
modules.src/share.js: Web Share API + clipboard fallback; PLAY_URL; buildSharePayload(vibeScore)
modules.src/content/cards_klub.js: 30 Klub set cards: 6 per role (Tonac/Host/Content Creator/Logistika/Obezbedjenje), 4 Common (power 1-2) + 2 Rare (power 3-4) per role, unique names and flavor
modules.src/content/cards_outdoor.js: 5 Outdoor signature cards: 1 per role, power 5, outdoor-themed names/flavor
modules.src/content/cards_intimate.js: 5 Intimate signature cards: 1 per role, power 5, intimate venue themed
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: 8 Pera Period micro-aforizmi for synergy trigger moments (displayed as overlay flash on synergy bonus >= 4)
modules.src/content/brand_hooks.js: Brand CTA strings: MKDSLend taglines, Guncati CTA, Kluboslavija secondary mention
modules.styles/base.css: Layout: mobile-first, full-height flexbox, game area max-width 480px centered, font import
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD: vibe meter, phase indicator, slot grid 5-col, card hand row, button styles
modules.styles/game.css: Card animations: slide-in draw, assign snap, synergy pulse glow, phase transition fade, vibe bump keyframes
modules.styles/theme.css: Dark event palette: #0d1117 bg, #1a1a2e card bg, #e8d5b7 text; role accents; rarity gold border for Rare
